select * from ( SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.price_review_date, q.price_list, q.quotation_id, (SELECT m.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master m WHERE m.bp_id = p.tenant_id) bp_name, p.business_type, (SELECT t.description FROM hls_business_type t WHERE t.business_type = p.business_type AND t.document_category = p.document_category) business_type_n, (case when p.industry_category = 'FIRST_SPECIAL_INDUSTRY' then '一类专项行业' when p.industry_category = 'SECOND_SPECIAL_INDUSTRY' then '二类专项行业' else '其他' end) industry_category_n, (case when p.key_support_area ='Y' then '重点支持区域 ' else '' end) || (case when p.green_leasing = 'Y' then '绿色租赁业务 ' else '' end) || (case when p.epidemic_prevention = 'Y' then '防疫相关业务 ' else '' end) || (case when p.nada = 'Y' then '无 ' else '' end) AS special_category, (SELECT wm_concat(bp_name || ',' || v.meaning || ',' || (SELECT v.MEANING FROM hls_bp_credit_rate r, sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'HLS.EXTERNAL_RATING_RESULT' AND v.code_value = r.identification_result_o AND r.bp_id = b.bp_id and rownum=1)) FROM prj_project_bp b, hls_bp_master m, sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE b.project_id = p.project_id AND b.bp_categroy = 'PRJ_PROJECT' AND b.bp_type IN ('TENANT', 'TENANT_SEC', 'WARRANTOR', 'VENDER') AND v.code = 'STRATEGIC_BP_TYPE' AND v.code_value = m.strategic_bp_type AND b.bp_id = m.bp_id) AS bp_type_n,
(q.finance_amount/100000000)finance_amount, nvl((SELECT SUM(nvl(pqc.due_amount, 0)) FROM quotation_cashflow_history pqc WHERE pqc.quotation_id = q.quotation_id AND pqc.cf_item = 90), 0) draft_amount,
nvl((SELECT SUM(nvl(pqc.paynote_charge_fee, 0)) FROM quotation_cashflow_history pqc WHERE pqc.quotation_id = q.quotation_id AND pqc.cf_item = 90), 0) paynote_charge_fee, (SELECT nvl((SUM(pqc.due_amount) / q.finance_amount), 0) FROM quotation_cashflow_history pqc WHERE pqc.quotation_id = q.quotation_id AND pqc.cf_item IN (51, 53)) deposit_ratio, (SELECT nvl((SUM(pqc.due_amount) / q.finance_amount), 0) FROM quotation_cashflow_history pqc WHERE pqc.quotation_id = q.quotation_id AND pqc.cf_item = 3) lease_charge_ratio, (SELECT v.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'RENTING_FREQUENCY' AND v.code_value = q.renting_frequency) renting_frequency_n, round(q.xirr * 100, 2) || '%' xirr_n,
(select s.description from sys_user s where s.user_id = p.host_project_manager) host_project_manager_n, (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = p.host_unit_id) host_unit_name, (select u.description from sys_user u where u.user_id = p.price_review_person) price_review_person_n, q.change_category, (case when q.change_category = 'PRJ_BEFORE_NOTICE' then '普通' when q.change_category = 'PRJ_BEFORE_NOTICE_CHANGE' then '变更' end) change_category_n FROM prj_project p, prj_quotation_history q WHERE p.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND p.data_type = 'NORMAL' AND q.source_document_category = 'PRJ_PROJECT' AND q.source_document_id = p.project_id AND (q.change_category = 'PRJ_BEFORE_NOTICE' or q.change_category = 'PRJ_BEFORE_NOTICE_CHANGE') ORDER BY p.project_name) t
t.project_id = #{projectId}

pq.quotation_id = pqc.quotation_id and nvl(pqc.history_flag, 'N') = 'Y'

SELECT pp.CONTRACT_NUMBER || '-01-' || nvl( ( SELECT LPAD( MAX( substrb ( pq1.payment_number, - 2 ) ) + 1, 2, 0 ) FROM prj_quotation pq1 WHERE pq1.DATA_CLASS = 'CONTRACT_PLAN' AND pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' AND pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID ), '01' ) FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
